prompt: How does one Compose file make an AI application easier to inspect? Evidence run 20260923-173256.

fresh.answer: In order to make an AI application easier to inspect, one can use the Compose file to organize and document the application model, including service declarations, container definitions, dependencies, startup order, and endpoints, as stated in [1]. By doing so, it becomes easier to understand the structure and flow of the application. Additionally, [2] suggests that using similarity search to retrieve relevant grounding passages before the model generates an answer can also aid in the inspection process. Finally, being aware of production boundaries as mentioned in [3] can help anticipate and address potential issues in deployment, making the application easier to inspect.
